description: Draft combiner internal parameters. Loaded from draft_combiner.json if not inlined.

acceptance_ema_alpha.description: EMA decay for per-source acceptance rate tracking

latency_per_position_us.description: Estimated latency saved per accepted draft position in microseconds

min_utility_threshold.description: Minimum utility score for a candidate to be included. 0 = accept all.

coverage_discount_floor.description: Floor for expert coverage discount (INV-A). P(accept) is never discounted below this fraction.
